analysis: Reviewed the modified docs/reference/configuration.md. The changed ranges are the 'Last updated' date at line 3, a row at ~964 (models[].resource_policy_sha256 now describes the policy digest composition, including optional Qwen tensor-assistant fields, and states this build declares none), line 1104, and lines 1635-1636 (Qwen27 TP assistant policy rows). This is documentation only, with no code, config default or control changes. The supplied base (lines 1458-1657) and head (lines 1-313) excerpts do not overlap, so I could not directly diff the 1635-1636 edits. The documented content (the tensorAssistant never coexists with nativeMember, which is refused at save/load and by the leader; the assistant is discovered only for local-only clusters; speculative decoding has no parity qualification, so it is not offered to the coordinator) is consistent with a restrictive posture, and I see no weakening of authorization, attestation, encryption or prefix-cache controls (T-041, T-053, T-054, TB-011). The head excerpt's visible text, including the prefix-cache default and the add-on/sandbox settings, appears unchanged by this PR; its variables are documented as not forwarded to launchd. Remaining questions: the truncated patch excerpt hides the full content of the lines 964, 1104 and 1635-1636 edits. Whether the documented resource-policy digest matches the source (ClusterPublicTensorAssistant.resourcePolicyFields) is outside the supplied evidence. This documentation-only PR raises no security concern from what was supplied.
